svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: For a welder. Sleeve: 700 mm of 168 x 2 mm pipe. Shell: 2 mm sheet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rolled to 420 mm outside, 600 mm tall. Bottom: 2 mm ring, 420 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside, 168 mm hole. Weld water-tight; the sleeve stands 50 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: out of the top and the bottom (the two sockets).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fins: three 6 mm plates 85 x 140 mm, welded radially to the shell,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one at the front, one back right, one back left (120 degrees

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: apart), 60 mm up the shell and 80 mm below it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 11 mm holes per fin: 245 mm from the axis, 15 mm above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: jacket's underside; 267 mm from the axis, 52 mm below it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tap socket: 1/2 in socket welded 40 mm above the bottom, on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: right side. Open top: no lid welded, nothing sealed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leak test with water before painting. High-temperature paint outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: holds water overnight; the sleeve slides over a 160 mm pipe.
